howto: Swipe, or press the arrow keys or WASD, to turn the snake.
Eat the food: each bite makes you one longer and a little faster.
Hitting a wall or your own body ends the run.
tips: You cannot reverse straight back into yourself; turn twice to double back.
Keep to the edges early and leave the middle open for when you are long.
The snake speeds up with every bite, so plan turns a square ahead.
Swipes work anywhere on the board, not just near the snake.

controls.keyboard: Arrow keys or WASD turn; Space starts and restarts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe in the direction you want to go. Pause button bottom left.

difficulty: Easy starts slow and never gets very fast; Normal starts medium; Hard starts fast and speeds up further. Each bite speeds the snake up.

cheats.effect: Walls wrap round to the other side

features.one-tap-start: Tap, Space or any arrow key on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap or Space on the GAME OVER card
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated four-way swipe; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: GAME OVER / PERFECT! card with length and best
